title: Local network
description: Use Arenile from other PCs, tablets and phones on the beach Wi-Fi, on the same archive as this PC.

off.title: Local network mode is off
off.description: Turn it on in the desktop app settings (or from the system tray menu): other devices on the beach Wi-Fi will be able to open the panel. Connections from outside the local network stay refused.

server.title: This page is about the desktop app
server.description: Local network mode exists only in the desktop edition. This instance is already reachable at its address: use the Devices page to connect phones and PCs.

address.title: Panel address
address.description: On the other devices connected to the same Wi-Fi, open this address in the browser.
address.qrHint: On a phone or tablet you can also scan the QR code with the camera.

fingerprint.title: Certificate fingerprint
fingerprint.description: The connection is encrypted with a certificate created by this PC. Before accepting it in a browser, check that the SHA-256 fingerprint is identical to this one.

browser.title: First access from a browser
browser.description: The browser shows a warning the first time, because the certificate is not issued by a public authority. This is expected on the beach network.
browser.step1: Connect the device to the same Wi-Fi as this PC.
browser.step3: At the "Your connection is not private" warning, open the certificate details.
browser.step4: Compare the SHA-256 fingerprint with the one shown above: every character must match.
browser.step5: If it matches, choose "Advanced" and then "Proceed" (Safari: "Visit this website"). If it does not, do not continue and tell the manager.
browser.hint: The certificate does not change on restart: the warning comes back only when the certificate is renewed. Reserve a fixed IP address for this PC in the router so that the panel address stays the same.

apps.title: Mobile app and desktop app in remote mode
apps.description: With "Pair a device" the QR carries the address, the certificate fingerprint and a one-time code.
apps.security: The apps check the certificate fingerprint themselves, so they show no warning: if someone impersonated this PC, the connection would be refused.
apps.guarantee: There is still a single server: bookings and takings from other devices go into the same archive, with the same guarantees against double bookings.
